full_prompt_en: An elaborate vintage storybook illustration brings two young women close together within a circular arch of vines and pale flowers. The taller figure behind has copper-red ringlets, a cream ruffled bonnet with a dark ribbon, and a composed gaze directed toward the viewer. In front of her, a smaller fair-haired figure turns left in profile beneath a broad white pleated headdress. Both wear high, lace-trimmed collars and muted red garments, with carefully drawn curls, pleats, and floral ornaments. A white bird rises at the lower left near the smaller figure, while another pale small animal or bird shape peeks through blossoms at the lower right. Behind them, olive-gray leaves and tan stems fill the space densely but remain quieter than the bright faces and headdresses. Thin brown contour lines and restrained shading give the image the feel of an aged illustrated print. The faces are softly modeled with cream, blush, and light gray, while clothing and plants use flatter, more patterned areas. A circular tan arch frames the heads and organizes the abundant botanical detail. The composition has shallow depth, relying on overlap and the contrast between pale fabric and darker foliage. Gentle diffuse light brightens the two faces and white feathers without creating hard shadows. The whole frame feels formal, tender, and slightly enchanted through ornamental line, antique color, and closely nested figures.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅繁复的复古故事书插画把两位年轻女子紧靠着安放在藤蔓与浅色花朵组成的圆拱内。后方较高的人物有铜红色环状卷发、带深色系带的奶油白褶饰软帽，以沉静目光望向观者。她前面较小的浅发人物戴宽阔白色百褶头饰，朝左侧转成侧脸。两人都穿带蕾丝饰边的高领和低饱和红色衣物，卷发、布褶和花饰描绘细致。左下方一只白鸟靠近较小的人物升起，右下角另一只浅色小动物或鸟的形态从花间探出。身后橄榄灰色叶片和褐色枝茎密密填满空间，却比明亮的面孔和头饰更安静。纤细棕色轮廓线与克制阴影让图像具有旧插画印件的气质。面部由奶油白、浅红和淡灰柔和塑造，衣物和植物则是更平整、更富纹样的区域。一道褐色圆拱框住头部，并组织丰盛的植物细节。构图纵深浅，依赖重叠和浅色布料对深叶的对比。柔和漫射光照亮两张脸和白色羽毛，没有制造硬影。整幅画借装饰线条、古旧色彩与亲密嵌套的人物，显得庄重、温柔且略带魔法感。
style_prompt_en: The vintage storybook image combines fine brown outlines, soft cream and blush modeling, and dense olive-gray botanical pattern on an aged tan ground. Pale pleated shapes and softly lit focal planes stand forward, while darker leaves and small blossoms form a shallow ornamental surround. A broad circular arc organizes the center, echoed by smaller curls, petals, and folded fabric edges. The surface resembles an old printed illustration: detailed but slightly muted, with faint grain and restrained shadow. Linework remains delicate even in the richest areas, and adjacent shapes are separated more by contour and overlap than by strong perspective. Warm red accents punctuate the otherwise quiet cream-olive palette. Diffuse light keeps the pale regions luminous and the darker pattern gentle. The whole frame feels formal, tender, and quietly enchanted through antique color, rhythmic ornament, and meticulous hand-drawn detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅复古故事书图像在旧褐色底面上结合纤细棕色轮廓、柔和的奶油白与浅红塑造，以及密集的橄榄灰色植物纹样。浅色百褶形态和柔光照亮的焦点平面向前浮出，深色叶片与小花则形成浅纵深的装饰包围。宽阔圆弧组织中央，又被较小的卷曲、花瓣和折叠布边呼应。表面像一张旧插画印件：细节丰富却色彩稍被压低，带淡淡颗粒和克制阴影。即使在最繁密处，线描仍纤巧，相邻形体更多靠轮廓和重叠，而非强透视分开。暖红重点点破其他地方安静的奶油白与橄榄色盘。漫射光让浅色区域发亮，深色纹样保持温和。整幅画因古旧色彩、富节奏的装饰与精细手绘细节而显得庄重、温柔且安静地充满奇想。
theme_en: Two bonneted girls among white birds and flowers
theme_zh: 白鸟与花间戴软帽的两位少女
name: Adrienne Segur
